hypothesis: L015 showed that a cluster1 extra_trees/raw expert worsened pooled MAE and produced extreme errors on both reported-zero and high-Tc cases. Replacing only that expert with the smoother hist_gradient_boosting/raw estimator may reduce those extremes while avoiding the severe positive-Tc underprediction repeatedly associated with log1p targets; cluster0 and cluster2 remain on the G01 extra_trees/raw fallback to isolate the estimator change.
falsification: The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted training OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K, representing at least the required 0.01 K gain over A05, and positive-Tc MAE is at most the fixed G01 guard of 8.832165507919859 K. Any route or subgroup improvement without both conditions is only a development tradeoff.
reason: The required minimum remains pending at 15 of 22 successful unique cycles. This untried configuration follows directly from the completed single-cluster extra_trees/raw ablations and isolates whether estimator smoothing can rescue the particularly harmful cluster1 specialization without confounding target, input, or fallback changes.
